profile.headline: Principal Engineer at Keeper Security Inc.
profile.summary:
Experienced mobile and web software engineer with a proven track record of releasing great software in an agile environment:

Programming Languages: Swift, C#, Objective-C, Java, C/C++, Javascript, Ruby, & PHP

Client Dev : iOS, MacOS, Xamarin, Android, & SQLite

Web Application Dev : API development using Java/Tomcat/JSON, JSP/servlets, Apache Struts, PHP, HTML, CSS, JQuery, MySQL, Oracle, JDBC, & general SQL

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Keeper® is the world's leading mobile app for protecting and securing passwords and private data. Among the Top 5 Grossing Productivity apps on iOS and Android, we create best-in-class password management and digital vault software to protect businesses and consumers from cyber theft.

Technical leader in iOS and macOS development for Keeper’s password management and secure messaging products utilizing end-to-end encryption, Swift, Objective-C, and Xamarin native technologies.

- Lead developer for macOS implementation of KeeperChat, a secure messaging desktop and mobile application incorporating a Xamarin native codebase, with 75% shared business logic among all platforms (OSX, iOS, Android, & Windows), and end-to-end encryption to safeguard user data on the device and in transit.

- Architect for Keeper’s flagship password management iOS application, including design and development of client/server login framework, two-factor authentication, record management, security, and enterprise management features.

- Lead developer for KeeperFill for Apps on macOS with the goal of providing a native resident application that detects secure login and payment forms in native apps to streamline the user experience in form-filling, saving, and management of the user’s secure information.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Scrum team mobile tech lead tasked with architecting the data delivery and client display of Epocrates/athenahealth medical reference content. Using agile methodologies, developed new products using Swift and Xamarin, and continued to improve existing products and features for iOS, Android, and web services platforms.

- Addressed shortcomings of legacy content delivery system by designing an extensible, platform-agnostic JSON content container format and API specification to enable data-driven, dynamic delivery of Epocrates’ medical reference content (drug and disease monographs, treatment guidelines, etc.) to web and mobile clients. 

- Reduced mobile client development time by adopting Xamarin to build native cross-platform components to cache, parse, and display JSON data from new content delivery API.

- Improved user experience for athenaText (http://www.athenahealth.com/practice/athenatext/secure-text-messaging) secure messaging application by partnering with UX design team to build well-designed user experience flows on iOS and Android mobile clients. 

- Created athenaText components for user workflows such as registration, onboarding, security setup, credential verification, colleague invitations, composing new messages, viewing and sending messages on an existing thread, and additional enterprise management features.

- Developed athenaText web services built on a Java/Tomcat/Spring/Oracle server stack that allows for scalable, high-throughput messaging support for web and mobile clients.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development of new products and features for Epocrates Essentials on iOS, Android, Palm, Windows Mobile, and web services platforms. Liaised with offshore mobile development team to increase overall productivity and efficiency of project task completion. 

- Lead mobile developer for Epocrates Provider Directory (http://www.epocrates.com/e/ProviderDirectory) feature on iOS and Android platforms. Collaborated with web services and UX teams to create a mobile search application enabling users to perform searches for medical providers in their area by name and specialty from a database of over 700k U.S clinicians. Developed identity verification and profile editing workflows to allow providers to claim and edit their professional information appearing in the directory. 

- Technical lead for project to port commercial “virtual rep” feature set from iOS to Android platform, including Essential Points, eSampling, and Contact Manufacturer functionality. 

- Maintained Rx drug and infectious disease references, Dx disease guide, Lab diagnostic reference, Medical Resource Center applications, and commercial "virtual rep" features. Proficient in iOS, Palm OS, Win32 API’s, desktop conduit development, and client/server data synchronization techniques.

- Integral part of the Java re-architecture effort of the Epocrates ecommerce website. Designed and developed Apache Struts MVC/EJB n-tier web application architecture for the Epocrates Portal v1.0 and v2.0. Implemented EJB, database, and business logic components, including ecommerce integration with Verisign.  Portal is an integral part of Epocrates e-business presence.

positions.title: E-Business Consultant
positions.description: Provided technical expertise in object-oriented design and development of scalable, robust multi-tier web applications for clients such as Hewlett Packard, Agilent Technologies, and Graviton Inc.
